## Checks

- [ ] `make lint` passes
- [ ] `make test` passes on Moodle 5.3 and 4.5 (or CI is green)
- [ ] New behaviour has PHPUnit and/or Behat tests, including permission and error cases
- [ ] Strings added to `lang/en` and `lang/es`
- [ ] `amd/build` rebuilt (`make fix`) if `amd/src` changed
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] Screenshot refreshed (`make screenshot`) if the UI changed visibly
